name: Strap comfort and cuff stiffness
about: Below 4.3 kPa (32 mmHg, capillary closing pressure, Landis 1930) a strap can be worn all day. Up to about 13.3 kPa (100 mmHg) is tolerable for short use; above that it hurts and restricts blood flow (blood-pressure-cuff territory). Approximate guidelines.
cuff_note: Strap plus soft tissue: about 2-5 N/mm across the limb, less along it (straps slide). Approximate.
